program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define seeds (filter (lambda (p) (let ((v (at g (first p) (second p)))) (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 5))))) (grid-positions g)))
    (define (dist-from start)
      (define dist (make-hash))
      (define queue (list start))
      (hash-set! dist start 0)
      (define (bfs)
        (unless (empty? queue)
          (let* ((p (first queue)) (r (first p)) (c (second p)) (d0 (hash-ref dist p)))
            (set! queue (rest queue))
            (for ([d (in-list cardinal-deltas)])
              (let ((nr (+ r (first d))) (nc (+ c (second d))))
                (when (and (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
                           (not (= (at g nr nc) 5))
                           (not (hash-has-key? dist (list nr nc))))
                  (hash-set! dist (list nr nc) (+ d0 1))
                  (set! queue (append queue (list (list nr nc)))))))
            (bfs))))
      (bfs)
      dist)
    (define seed-dists (map (lambda (p) (list p (at g (first p) (second p)) (dist-from p))) seeds))
    (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
      (lambda (r c)
        (if (= (at g r c) 5)
            5
            (let* ((p (list r c))
                   (cands (filter (lambda (sd) (hash-has-key? (third sd) p)) seed-dists)))
              (if (empty? cands)
                  0
                  (second (first (sort cands
                                       (lambda (a b)
                                         (let ((da (hash-ref (third a) p)) (db (hash-ref (third b) p)))
                                           (if (= da db) (< (second a) (second b)) (< da db))))))))))))))
